title: RAW404 operationalization: consume the complete 33-group reading and close its assertion, reference and temporal structure
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. The original RAW404 remains unchanged. Its 24 whole-form guesses and eight clause constructions have only a documented manual draft and literal/hash/count check in the reviewed primaries. This proposal specifies a first complete typed reading and consequence evaluation of the same P12-projected 33 groups. It does not claim a new semantic law, independent meaning evidence or a literal diplomatic decipherment. The diplomatic salche'dy and saii@208; remain unresolved, not silently normalized.
relation_to_parent: First proposed operational evaluation of this complete inherited hypothetical reading, subject to root selection; no novelty claim from restating its meanings.

eight_clause_constructions.reading: Weaving, as opposed to unweaving, the cloth.
eight_clause_constructions.binding: A=[WEAVE,UNRAVEL], both with patient C. Action names only; zero executed actions.

eight_clause_constructions.reading: Completion of the cloth is a prerequisite for marriage.
eight_clause_constructions.binding: P=prerequisite(FINISHED(C),MARRIAGE(W)); neither completion nor marriage is asserted here.

eight_clause_constructions.reading: In secret, the woman unravels the cloth.
eight_clause_constructions.binding: U=habitual UNRAVEL(W,C), concealed from public participants O. qoky introduces W; otchey introduces concealed status. No exact nightly quantity.

eight_clause_constructions.reading: By day she publicly pledges that prerequisite.
eight_clause_constructions.binding: PLEDGE(W,O,P,DAY). The pledge takes C2, the most recent proposition of prerequisite type; C3 is an action, not an eligible proposition.

eight_clause_constructions.reading: Until the cloth is finished, she weaves it row by row.
eight_clause_constructions.binding: V=habitual WEAVE(W,C), prospectively bounded by FINISHED(C), with ROW ROW interpreted distributively. The endpoint is not asserted as reached by this clause.

eight_clause_constructions.reading: The first and second activities on that cloth have daytime and nighttime, respectively.
eight_clause_constructions.binding: C1 first=WEAVE binds C5 V to DAY; C1 second=UNRAVEL binds C3 U to NIGHT. qokedy requires the same C. No new action or event is introduced.

eight_clause_constructions.reading: A handmaid informs the wooers; they discover the concealed action at night.
eight_clause_constructions.binding: INFORM(H,O,U); DISCOVER(O,U,NIGHT). The written qody is the report recipient and following discovery subject. The common concealed-action object is U. Discovery does not manufacture a further unweaving event.

eight_clause_constructions.reading: Then, under compulsion, the woman weaves the cloth to completion.
eight_clause_constructions.binding: After C7 discovery: actual WEAVE(W,C) under compulsion, capped by SAII at FINISHED(C). Neither a marriage nor an additional unweaving is asserted.

nine_grammar_conditions.rule: Literal whole forms and typed constructions only. Inherited action names are not occurrence counts: C1 has two action names, C3 one habitual unweaving assertion, C5 one habitual weaving assertion, C8 one bounded weaving assertion. No character, suffix or segment meaning is inferred.

ACTION contrast ACTION OBJECT constructs an ordered pair of action types sharing its following object. It does not execute either action. STATE SOCIAL_ACT constructs a prospective prerequisite proposition. These two constructions are nominal/propositional contexts; bare action clauses elsewhere assert the written action.

There is one persistent cloth C. Its first literal qokedy introduces C; later qokedy refers to C. Inherited weave/unravel/finish predicates have C as patient by their unchanged meanings. A written worker noun binds the worker; subsequent omitted worker arguments use the most recent compatible worker. W first appears in C3, before every actor-requiring asserted clause. C2 is initially an open proposition and receives W when PLEDGE binds it; no forward invisible person or action is inserted.

Modifiers precede their action head, except a postposed actor and an action-final completive. TIME preceding a speech predicate attaches to that speech act. UNTIL STATE ACTION marks a prospective endpoint and does not assert its achievement. ACTION ROW ROW uses the explicitly hypothetical distributive noun repetition construction. It has no number, duration, recurrence count or extra action semantics.

PLEDGE selects the most recent prerequisite proposition. A public/secret modifier shares the participant class PublicParticipants, explicitly named as wooers in C7. Until that noun is read, O is an unfilled participant slot, not an invented independent agent. Completion predicates in C2 and C5 and the endpoint in C8 all apply to C.

FIRST SECOND RESPECTIVELY OBJECT TIME1 TIME2 assigns times to the most recent asserted habitual actions of the two ordered types with that same object. The pair is C1, actions are C5 and C3, object is C, times are DAY and NIGHT. All required frames must already exist; failure to find either is an error, not permission to add an event. This clause makes no new action.

PERSON INFORM PERSON DISCOVER TIME is a serial construction: the second person is recipient of INFORM and subject of DISCOVER; the final time modifies DISCOVER only. Both predicates take the most recent concealed-action frame as content. No additional UNRAVEL is generated by either predicate.

The passage has descriptive habitual clauses and one later discovery/completion sequence. C3 and C5 describe the same prior work period; their textual order does not impose alternating executions. C7 introduces discovery of that period; THEN in C8 explicitly advances after it. No exact cycle count, no equal daily/nightly amount, no silent reset, no inferred executed marriage.

Clause boundaries are the explicit hypothesized eight spans, justified only conditionally by these construction signatures. They are not observed historical punctuation. This is a fully specified interpretive reading, not a demonstrated uniquely recoverable parser, and the rule list has not been fit or tested elsewhere.

all_limitations: All 24 whole-form meanings remain epistemically unknown; seven are inherited hypotheses and 17 are newly invented hypotheses. Filling 33 cells is not decoding accuracy or meaning evidence.
The 17 new types occupy 18 positions. Sixteen are singletons; only shckhedy repeats. This permits extensive fitting freedom and does not independently establish the narrative.

ROW ROW as distributive row by row, daytime public pledge, the retrospective two-time construction and serial report/discovery grammar are new assumptions without identified target or historical-grammar evidence. Row by row and the exact time of the pledge are not stated in the bounded Homer episode.

The source omits neither three years/fourth year, torches, Laertes, anticipated death, the excuse concerning wasted spinning/reproach, nor speaker ownership; this target draft has no written values for those source details. It also weakens caught-in-the-act to discovery at night. It is therefore not a complete translation or exact encoding of Odyssey II.93-110.

The draft reports a public pledge but does not identify Antinous as the hostile outer narrator or give the full quotation structure. C2 is reported content when C4 binds it, not a narrator assertion of a fulfilled condition.

Same cloth, shared worker, PublicParticipants cataphora, typed retrospective references and narrative aspect are stipulated. Directed composition, reusable parts, whole-form residuals and wider entry effects remain unexplained by this paragraph-level lexicon.

RAW403 fixes qokedy=goat, shedy=attendant, chedy=cabbage. This draft fixes qokedy=cloth, shedy=daytime, chedy=completion. The drafts cannot be one unchanged monosemous lexicon. No polysemy, selector switch, paragraph-specific dictionary or change to either parent is adopted.

W91 sol/qokeey proof meanings remain failed. GDT981 F remains contradicted and R unconfirmed; no r/l states are inherited. GDT820 allows more than one account of repetition, not an automatic distributive rule. GDT983 does not select a reduplication expansion or a meaning.

One already exposed ZL report-owned paragraph only. No alternate-reader corroboration or new historical source channel to the manuscript is claimed. No reserve, new Voynich page/image, f84/f84r/f116v, decoder, statistic or outside contact.
unchanged_parent.cost: All 24 meanings remain unconfirmed. Seventeen were added to the parent RAW378, sixteen of those are singletons. No additional whole-word meanings are introduced by this operationalization. The two diplomatic discrepancies are NOT added to the dictionary.

executable_reading_contract.input: The literal projected whole forms, their actual group boundaries and line/locus provenance. The parser may not read the stored expected clause IDs/readings, use line numbers to choose productions, or accept a word by a default UNKNOWN transition.
executable_reading_contract.lexer: Use exactly the unchanged 24 whole-form hypotheses as typed values. WEAVE and UNRAVEL are action kinds until a production asserts an action. FINISHED is a state predicate, MARRIAGE an intended social-action type, DAY/NIGHT time phases, and ROW a work-unit noun. No character or suffix meanings. Lexical type assignment implements, rather than confirms, the existing guesses.

production_shapes.name: ACTION_PAIR
production_shapes.effect: Create an ordered action-kind pair sharing this cloth; create no executed action.

production_shapes.name: PREREQUISITE
production_shapes.effect: Create an open prerequisite proposition for the current cloth and an unfilled worker role; assert neither its antecedent nor the social act.

production_shapes.name: SECRET_HABIT
production_shapes.effect: Bind the written worker and assert a habitual action on the current cloth during the prior work period. Preserve the as-yet-unfilled public-audience role and concealment from that audience.

production_shapes.name: PUBLIC_PLEDGE
production_shapes.effect: Select the most recent prerequisite proposition by type, bind its worker to the current written worker, and create a speech-act assertion with the written time phase and shared audience slot.

production_shapes.name: UNTIL_HABIT
production_shapes.effect: Create a habitual action with the same worker/cloth and a prospective finish endpoint. Preserve distributive ROW ROW as one explicitly assumed construction, not a row count or two action events. Do not assert endpoint achievement.

production_shapes.name: RESPECTIVE_TIMES
production_shapes.effect: Resolve the latest ordered action-kind pair, then the latest existing habitual assertion of each kind with this same cloth. Attach the first phase to the first action and the second to the second. Missing or ambiguous eligible actions are reported, never manufactured.

production_shapes.name: REPORT_DISCOVERY
production_shapes.effect: Bind the audience slot to the written audience. Create INFORM(handmaid,audience,U) followed by DISCOVER(audience,U,time), both referring to the most recent concealed habitual action U. Create no new unweaving.

production_shapes.name: THEN_COMPLETE
production_shapes.effect: Create a bounded action after the preceding discovery, with the written worker, current cloth, compulsion and the compatible already-written finish endpoint. Assert that endpoint only here.

executable_reading_contract.parse_policy: Enumerate all complete parses admitted by these eight production shapes, preserving their order of consumption. Require every one of the 33 positions to be consumed exactly once. Do not force the stored eight spans; compare any resulting complete parse with the inherited construction interpretation afterward. If several survive, retain all and report whether their semantic consequences differ.
executable_reading_contract.typed_context: Maintain typed stores for the current cloth, current worker, open audience role, ordered action-kind pairs, prerequisite propositions, habitual-action assertions, their endpoints, and the most recent discovery. Only a matching construction can add or update a store entry. Opaque lexical guesses do not supply arbitrary extra values.
executable_reading_contract.forward_binding: The unfilled audience in SECRET/PLEDGE is a role variable, not a newly invented person; bind it when the written AUDIENCE is reached. PREREQUISITE’s worker is similarly open until PLEDGE binds it using the already-written WORKER. Reject unresolved roles at the block end. Do not require an independently confirmed name to bind these explicit hypothetical roles.
executable_reading_contract.endpoint_clarification: For THEN_COMPLETE, resolve the latest endpoint already supplied by UNTIL_HABIT with the same action kind, worker and cloth. This is the explicit operational mechanism for RAW404’s existing FINISHED(C) endpoint link; it is an added binding clarification, not a new observed grammar fact. A missing/mismatching endpoint is an error, not permission to insert FINISHED from a story label.
executable_reading_contract.no_shortcut: Construct the semantic graph from the parsed typed values and productions. Do not load parent clause readings/bindings as the computed answer, hardcode final FINISHED into the main driver, or accept an output merely because it equals an expected story string.
executable_reading_contract.type_table_status: A finite implementation transcription of the parent’s 24 guessed values, not a new lexical selection. Actual reference identities are bound by productions/context, not by storing completed clauses or final story outcomes in lexical entries.

full_assertion_and_temporal_consequences.assertions: Two habitual action assertions U=UNRAVEL(W,C) and V=WEAVE(W,C), one public PLEDGE, one INFORM, one DISCOVER, and one later bounded WEAVE action E. These are assertion frames, not six counted physical action occurrences; habitual multiplicity remains unspecified.
full_assertion_and_temporal_consequences.prior_period: U and V concern the same prior work period. Their textual order C3 before C5 is not execution order. The fixed respective-time rule yields phase(V)=DAY and phase(U)=NIGHT. PLEDGE has phase DAY. No exact dates, daily/nightly quantities, repeated cycle count or exact cancellation is inferred.
full_assertion_and_temporal_consequences.disclosure: INFORM and DISCOVER share U as content and the written wooers as recipient/discovery subject. Only DISCOVER establishes the post-discovery knowledge of that content; receiving a report alone need not be treated as independent truth. Earlier concealment and later discovery occupy different temporal scopes, so they are not an atemporal contradiction.
full_assertion_and_temporal_consequences.order: The prior work assertions and pledge precede the discovery stage. INFORM is not later than the ensuing DISCOVER in the declared serial construction. DISCOVER is at NIGHT. THEN places E strictly after DISCOVER; the time phase of E is unspecified.
full_assertion_and_temporal_consequences.endpoint: Only E asserts FINISHED(C). C2 states a prospective prerequisite, C5 supplies a prospective endpoint, and C8 reaches that same endpoint for the same cloth. No MARRIAGE event is generated. Its absence from the assertion graph is not an assertion that marriage can never occur.
full_assertion_and_temporal_consequences.state_ceiling: No exact cloth-progress dynamics are supplied by RAW404. Do not invent a row length, initial row inventory, monotone daily increment, equality of undone/woven work, or a terminal marriage. The evaluated consequence is the complete assertion/reference/temporal graph, not a numerical weaving simulation.
reused_content_inputs: The same FINISHED(C) predicate is used prospectively in PREREQUISITE and UNTIL_HABIT, then as the endpoint of the later bounded action; their assertedness differs.
The same concealed U is the content of the earlier secrecy assertion and of both INFORM and DISCOVER; the audience and time scope must be preserved.
The ordered pair [WEAVE,UNRAVEL] is introduced as types before either relevant habitual assertion and later resolves to V and U despite their opposite textual introduction order.

fully_specifiable_schedule_fork.source: RAW404 itself states that a literal schedule swap changes which written activity occurs at night, with no empirical discrimination claimed.
fully_specifiable_schedule_fork.fixed_change: Retain the same target, all whole-form hypotheses, action/object/worker references and all eight shapes, but test an explicitly separate reverse pairing convention in RESPECTIVE_TIMES: first action gets the second phase, second action gets the first. This changes one operational pairing rule; it is not the original rule and must never replace it after outcomes.
fully_specifiable_schedule_fork.different_output: Original: V at DAY, U at NIGHT. Reverse fork: V at NIGHT, U at DAY. DISCOVER remains at NIGHT in both. Because RAW404 already weakens caught-in-the-act to discovery at night, a daytime-U fork must NOT be rejected by silently requiring discovery to coincide with an ongoing U event.
fully_specifiable_schedule_fork.evaluation: Both may be internally coherent. Compare their computed consequences with the already-owned narrative summary: the source says daytime weaving and nighttime unweaving. This is a source-consistency distinction conditional on the guessed translation, not independent manuscript evidence or a p-value.

retained_incomplete_rivals: RAW378’s honest alternating technical process, two-cloth account and all-clauses-as-executed-facts sketches remain visible. They do not have complete fixed 33-group dictionaries/grammars here, so this trial must not pretend to refute them with synthetic negations of the original definitions.

RAW414 uses the same projected target for a balneological interpretation but its reviewed V2 has no complete component semantics or source guard binding; it is not a fair executable alternative without a separate completed contract.
RAW403’s transport dictionary conflicts with RAW404 on shared forms. Neither dictionary is merged, repaired by polysemy or selected through this local trial.
preexisting_alternatives.validation_fixtures_only: Wrong patient/worker, missing endpoint and accidental execution of nominal action names may test implementation error detection, but must not be advertised as independent semantic rivals or evidence selecting the story.

historical_and_manuscript_distinction.owned_source: The existing Murray-translation receipt for Odyssey II.93–110 within Antinous’s speech supports the narrative contrast, disclosure and forced completion. No new external source is acquired.
historical_and_manuscript_distinction.not_source_complete: RAW404 omits the three/four years, torches, Laertes, anticipated death, excuse/reproach, full hostile narrator ownership and quotation structure, and weakens discovery in the act. ROW ROW and the daytime pledge add details not stated in the bounded episode. Therefore even a perfectly coherent reading is not a complete encoding of the Homer passage.
historical_and_manuscript_distinction.target_claim: All target word meanings, clause signatures, same-cloth identity, cataphora and temporal aspect are assumptions. Parsing them successfully would establish their mutual executability on one owned projection, not identify the manuscript language, author, source or one confirmed word.
historical_and_manuscript_distinction.no_required_confirmed_anchor: The conditional test may begin from these disclosed guesses. No independent confirmed word is required to test internal closure; lack of independent meaning evidence limits the conclusion, not permission to formulate the hypothesis.

smallest_decision_changing_test_if_selec.question: Does the complete fixed RAW404 reading actually parse, resolve its written arguments and maintain coherent assertion/time scope, or do its prose claims hide an unresolved binding, duplicate event or contradictory role?
smallest_decision_changing_test_if_selec.minimum_work: One small parser/evaluator over the fixed projected paragraph, plus a separately written verifier of whole-position consumption, typed unifications, temporal constraints and generated semantic assertions. Keep a plain trace for every group. No corpus search, codebook solver, new source, image or general reference infrastructure.
smallest_decision_changing_test_if_selec.inverse_check: Regenerate the projected words from the ordered typed construction tree and the fixed lexicon/production templates without copying raw source tokens or stored expected sentence strings. Preserve the two ROW occurrences as the distributive construction and do not serialize them as a numeric quantity. Compare to all original group boundaries. This checks representation integrity, not meaning.
classification: COMPLETE_CONDITIONAL_READING: every group consumed, all roles resolved, coherent temporal graph and the stated original consequences obtained. Retain as an executable hypothetical reading of the P12 projection, still unconfirmed.
INCOMPLETE_BINDING or AMBIGUOUS_READING: unresolved or multiply resolved roles/productions remain. Preserve all parses and the exact missing dependency; no hidden clause or occurrence-specific fix.
INTERNAL_CONTRADICTION: the fixed original rule set entails incompatible types, participants or temporal/assertion requirements. Close this exact operational version without rewriting RAW404.
DIPLOMATIC_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED remains independent in every case because two literal source forms are outside the inherited lexicon. It is not repaired or relabeled a semantic contradiction.
smallest_decision_changing_test_if_selec.decision_change: A complete result upgrades this candidate only from a manual semantic draft to an executable complete conditional interpretation; a failure identifies a concrete gap or contradiction in that claimed completeness. Both change whether this specific draft is usable for a later whole-reading comparison. Neither warrants reserve use, confirmation or a new free dictionary.
smallest_decision_changing_test_if_selec.budget: At most 60 minutes total for root selection, preregistration, small implementation, separate validation and publication. Stop at a missing binding; no automatic parser extension, extra lexicon or new source search.
